text: {"final": {"verdict": "accept", "reason": "The edit matches the ticket and the actual code. best_route, sites_served, and trips_needed are unchanged; can_pass and load_network exist in logistics/access.py with the signatures used. passable_route correctly marks a route usable if truck or van can pass every road (can_pass: A=all, R=van only, X=none), picks the shortest by (km, id) like best_route, returns 'truck' only when a truck may use every road, else 'van', and None when nothing is usable. rerouted_sites compares route ids only (vehicle-only changes don't count), skips sites where either function returns None, and returns names sorted. Verified against data/network.json: SITE-CPL-B reroutes RT-05→RT-06 (R-08 closed), SITE-HGL-A reroutes RT-07→RT-08 (R-12 closed), while SITE-NVL-B and SITE-HGL-B keep the same route with a van, as the ticket requires."}}
reasoning:
Check the proposed edit against the ticket.

passable_route: usable if truck can pass every road OR van can pass every road. Pick shortest usable by (km, id). Return truck if truck_ok else van. Matches ticket.

rerouted_sites: iterate sites sorted by name; for each warehouse serving the site, compare passable_route route id vs best_route route id; if differ, include site, break. Returns list in name order. Ticket says "the sites, in name order, for which passable_route finds a route that is different from the route best_route picks". The proposed implementation iterates warehouses per site — if any warehouse's passable route differs from best, include site. That seems reasonable. Note: sites_served is per warehouse; the plan says "reuse sites_served per warehouse, or iterate warehouses/sites as needed" — the proposed iterates warehouses/sites, allowed.

Check best_route unchanged: yes, identical.

Check imports: can_pass imported from logistics.access — exists. load_network exists.

Check behavior with data:
- SITE-NVL-B: best_route picks RT-02 (22km). RT-02 uses R-01 (A), R-03 (R). Truck can't pass R-03, van can. So RT-02 usable with van. RT-03 (31km) all A, truck ok. Shortest usable is RT-02 (22) with van. passable_route returns RT-02, van. best_route returns RT-02, truck. Route ids same → not rerouted. Correct per ticket: vehicle-only change doesn't count. Good.
- SITE-CPL-B: best RT-05 (18km) uses R-08 (X) — not usable. RT-06 (26km) uses R-07 (A), R-09 (R) — van ok. passable returns RT-06, van. best RT-05. Rerouted. Good.
- SITE-HGL-A: best RT-07 (20km) uses R-12 (X) — not usable. RT-08 (27km) all A — truck ok. passable RT-08 truck. Rerouted. Good.
- SITE-HGL-B: RT-09 uses R-13 (R) — van only. passable RT-09 van, best RT-09 truck. Same route → not rerouted. Good.
- SITE-NVL-A: RT-01 all A, truck. Same. Not rerouted.
- SITE-CPL-A: RT-04 all A. Not rerouted.

rerouted_sites returns ["SITE-CPL-B", "SITE-HGL-A"] sorted. Correct.

Edge: passable_route returns None if no usable route; rerouted_sites handles None. Good.

One subtlety: in rerouted_sites, if passable is None but best exists — site not rerouted (no usable route). Ticket says "if either returns None the site is not rerouted" — matches plan. Good.

Also the proposed file keeps sites_served and trips_needed unchanged. best_route unchanged. All good.

Accept.
